## What's Changed

* Add explicit `click_method` selection across macOS, Linux, and Windows while keeping the default automatic route unchanged and making explicit modes fail closed. ([#47](https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/pull/47)) by [@tisfeng](https://github.com/tisfeng)
* Add macOS `sky_click` background delivery for supported windows without moving the real pointer or changing the foreground app or window order. ([#48](https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/pull/48)) by [@tisfeng](https://github.com/tisfeng)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0
